verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird's own IP pages describe litigation capability across IP types: an accolade says its team can 'handle all types of IP litigation', the patents page names a specific venue (UPC cases), and the trade marks page cites 'complex disputes'. The story is met because a venue is named, but the support rests mostly on third-party accolades quoted on the firm's pages. Missing for 10: specific case outcomes or court decisions described, trade-secret litigation evidence, and first-party detail on named courts beyond the UPC accolade.

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm litigates IP disputes — patent, trademark, or trade-secret — with courts, venues, or outcomes described on its own pages

citations.quote: Bird & Bird has the manpower necessary to handle multiple complex UPC cases at the same time
Bird & Bird has a composite IP team that can handle all types of IP litigation, which is extremely rare among foreign firms.
From global trade mark portfolio management and brand protection programmes to complex disputes
